notes.title: "Breaking Box" is participating in the "Steam Curator Conference 2023" event!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that our game Breaking Box are participating in the "Steam Curator Conference  2023" organized by the Steam China platform! 
During the "Steam Curator Conference 2023," Breaking Box will be available at a 30% discount. 
As it coincides with Multiplayer Game Week, the discount will be available until October 6th.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1077510/

We welcome everyone to invite their friends to play Breaking Box together!

[b]Recent Important Updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Observer Mode, allowing players to observe ongoing games in the room list and choose whether to join after the game ends.
[*] Added 21 new official multiplayer maps, including variety shows 10-19 and cooperative challenges 01-11, supporting 2-8 players.
[*] Fixed the issue of inconsistent synchronization of jump snap positions during online play.
[*]  In the "Always Upward" multiplayer mode, teammate height indicators have been added.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35116301/77d21bd1296c670d805511672e562a5e3db97571.png[/img]

We wish you a pleasant gaming experience!

notes.title: Incredible Mandy Version 1.3 Update
notes.content:
- Added new language options for Japanese, French, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese
- Deeply optimized install size, memory usage, loading speed and frame rate
- Added collectible stats in Chapters menu
- Added Achievement entry in Collectibles menu
- Added Collectibles entry in the pause menu
- Added Video entry under Options in the pause menu

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]Important Notes[/b][/h1]

1. Due to the compatibility-breaking changes in Floating Castle level, any player progress in this level will be lost after this update. All other levels are unaffected. We are very sorry for the inconvenience.

2. Based on the feedback from our players, we decided to remove all AI enemies which are not tied to puzzle solving. However, to keep the enemy related achievements accessible, we put them into the secret room level.

We made these changes only to deliver a better gaming experience. Your satisfaction is always our biggest drive to move forward.

Here's a complete list of changes and bug fixes:

[b]Changes[/b]

-Refined tutorial contents in Floating Castle
-Removed AI enemies which are not tied to puzzle solving. Keep a few of them in the secret room level
-The character won't be able to jump on a steep slope
-Slightly changed the angle of character fast turning
-Increased the size of big iron boxes to prevent the character from jumping onto them directly
-Added collapse damage detection for a platform in Magma Ruin
-The box near the double elevators in Sea Tower Part 1 won't be climbable

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

-Make sure the character and camera status is reset when reloading a scene
-The fade out effect after the character has fallen won't block the pause menu
-Fixed a bug in Floating Castle that caused the placed swords on the first fan blades to be floating in the air
-Fixed a physical collision issue of the second slingshot platform in Huge Woods
-Fixed the character alignment with the plant column when climbing it in Huge Woods
-Fixed some control issues of the double box puzzle in Magma Ruin
-Fixed an issue that caused the camera movement to be too sensitive when the character is on an elevator in Sea Tower
-Fixed a bug in Stars Lake that may cause the character to be irresponsive for several seconds after a cutscene is played

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Release Notes
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]

-Modified flying speed of energy butterflies, they will come to the vicinity of the character faster
-Record game progress right after the boss card collection screen has shown instead of when loading a subsequent scene
-Added some tutorial texts in Huge Woods, Sea Tower Part 1, Snowy Peak and the final boss fight
-Added explosion effect for the crystal in Sea Tower Part 1

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

-Fixed a bug of game clearance time calculation; if the player has beaten the game in time the achievement will automatically unlock the next time you run the game
-Enlarge the sister cutscene trigger in Floating Castle so the cutscene won’t be skipped
-Fixed an issue in Floating Castle that the fan may blow the character across the wall
-Fixed a bug in the lizard boss fight which may cause the central pillar to fall down multiple times in phase 2
-Fixed a bug in Sea Tower Part 1 that the sister won’t disappear after loading save from the collapsed bridge
-Fixed a bug in Sneak Valley which may cause the cutscene camera to get stuck
-Fixed an issue in Stars Lake that a light handle may be disabled too early
-Fixed a bug in warrior boss fight that the warrior may not attack after jump in phase 1 and 2
-Hide version number when playing animations from the collectibles menu

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]

-Added local data flags for all achievements; when the game starts, synchronize local data with the server side, then trigger achievement(s) unlock as needed
-Adjusted tutorial walkthrough in Floating Castle
-Adjusted camera position for the first handle in Floating Castle
-Added sound effects when the dragon appears for the first time in Floating Castle
-Extended hit check area of the core when the dragon boss glides down to attack
-Floating platforms won’t block arrow shots in the dragon boss fight
-Some puzzle logic changes of stage 3 in the lizard boss fight
-Crystals won’t block arrow shots in the lizard boss fight
-Changed 3D model of the sword stickers in the lizard boss fight
-Changed materials of some climbable bars in Sea Tower Part 1 and Stars Lake
-Controls won’t be locked for a few seconds when the character jumps out from a portal
-Changed the animation when the robot is grabbing something

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

-Fixed a bug of save file compatibility caused by version updates
-Fixed a movement bug of the first movable box in Floating Castle
-Fixed a bug which causing the character to be invincible when get hit in the lizard boss fight
-Fixed an issue in the lizard boss fight cutscene which may blow up the character
-Fixed a bug of the freeze timer which may cause the character to be irresponsive
-Fixed a bug of the robot not grabbing handles after reloading from saves in Stars Lake
-Fixed a bug of the elevator in the secret room when the character has restored on it
-Character actions won’t become slow motion when get hit, so the slow motion won’t affect subsequent scene events
-Fixed a bug which may cause the character to be irresponsive after jumping down and hitting the ground
-Fixed a bug of charging sword which may cause the visual effect not disappearing in a puzzle cutscene
-Fixed a bug of swords which may cause the first placed sword not disappearing when the 20 swords limit has been reached
-Assisted aiming now works correctly with nearby swords
-Aiming crosshair won’t disappear when the character is squatting
-Fixed materials on the butterfly springs and common elevators

notes.title: Incredible Mandy Demo Gets Update Along With Full Game Release
notes.content:
Thanks to our beta testers, we were able to fix a lot of bugs in the demo and the final game. Also we've made some important changes and improvements:

-Reduced the damage of sword explosion by 40%
-Improved character control feels of running, jumping and crouching
-Improved camera stability
-Improved rendering performance
-In-game music completed

notes.title: Demo Version 0.9.14 Release Notes
notes.content:
It's been quite a while since the last update of Incredible Mandy demo version. We've made a lot of changes and optimizations to the gaming experience. An incomplete list is as follows:

Changes

- Removed Lock Camera action, added Dodge action. The default key/button to Dodge is E/RT, Draw Bow is moved to Q/LT
- Tutorial text changes
- Some treasure chests contain items to increase the player's health bar
- Boss tentacle flashes before attack
- Added countdown sound effect to Light Gates and Light Pillars that are functional for a limited time
- Other new sound effects and music

Bug fixes

- Numerous player action bug fixes
- Fixed camera position bugs when game is loaded from a save
- Fixed SPOIL ALERT [spoiler]boss tail distortion[/spoiler] bug that causing the game to be impossible to proceed

notes.title: Incredible Mandy Demo Gets First Update
notes.content:
After the release of Incredible Mandy Demo version last week end, we’ve collected valuable feedback from you fellow players. Thus we’re able to make an update addressing several important issues as quick as possible. Full list is as follows:

[b]Changes[/b]

- Changed default key for crouch from Ctrl to C
- Several position and text changes of tutorial
- Changed color of swords and links for better visibility
- Added Load Last Save button in the pause menu
- Added version number in the lower left corner of main menu screen

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed wrong positioning of Big White Robot upon saves loaded
- Fixed a model-penetrating issue in the final puzzle of Floating Castle
- Fixed unstable camera control using mouse
- Fixed a sound effect looping bug when player is focusing energy
- Fixed several sound effect volumes related to player movement
- Fixed language detection and saving issues
